system.boundary: Build a closed-loop anesthesia delivery model in Simulink.
engineering_objects: F90-XMED-10 plant and controller described by the current public task contract

Measured output interfaces: bis_response, loss_of_consciousness_probability, cardiac_output_L_min, mean_arterial_pressure_mmHg, tolerance_of_laryngoscopy_probability, propofol_infusion_mg_s, remifentanil_infusion_ug_s
physical_paths: It must support BIS targets from 42 through 55.
Time must be monotonic and cover 0 through simulation_time_s without truncation.
functional_paths: A feedback controller must regulate BIS toward bis_target by commanding nonnegative, bounded propofol and remifentanil infusion rates.
The controller must respond to the simulated patient state rather than replaying a stored infusion schedule.
information_paths: patient_age_years, patient_height_cm, patient_weight_kg, patient_sex_binary, bis_target, simulation_time_s -> F90-XMED-10 plant/control path -> bis_response, loss_of_consciousness_probability, cardiac_output_L_min, mean_arterial_pressure_mmHg, tolerance_of_laryngoscopy_probability, propofol_infusion_mg_s, remifentanil_infusion_ug_s
modes_and_events: Build a closed-loop anesthesia delivery model in Simulink.

The patient model must include dynamic pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic behavior for propofol and remifentanil, their coupled effect on depth of anesthesia, and clinically meaningful hemodynamic responses.
The model must operate for patients from 18 to 80 years old, 150 to 200 cm tall, and 45 to 120 kg, with patient_sex_binary equal to 0 for female or 1 for male.
